integrity: The automorphism form is rederived directly from the defining bracket, and the orbit partition follows from its explicit action on coordinates. The finite-field sizes are checked by an independent exhaustive program on several fields and dimensions.
scientific_limitations: The class-wide classification from the source assumes characteristic different from 2; the element-orbit theorem for the fixed canonical algebra is characteristic-free.
Only single-element automorphism orbits are classified, not tuples, subalgebras, ideals, or endomorphisms.
A specialized or unindexed source may contain an equivalent orbit stratification.
title: Element orbits of \(L_n\) stabilize at \(2q+2\)
